get.summary: Teacher attendance — summary / branch_rule dekha (GET actions)
get.description:
action=summary -> ekta din-er shob teacher-er attendance summary dey (query: date [YYYY-MM-DD, default gotokal], branch_id [optional]). Bearer token lagbe.

action=branch_rule -> ekta branch-er full/half-day rule dekhay (query: branch_id [required]). Bearer token lagbe.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: shudhu action=summary er jonyo. Default: gotokal.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: action=branch_rule e required, action=summary e optional filter.

400.description: Missing required param (e.g. branch_id for branch_rule)

post.summary: Teacher attendance — checkin / checkout / run_batch / branch_rule set / mark_student_attendance (POST actions)
post.description:
action=checkin / checkout -> biometric device theke IN/OUT punch. X-Device-Key header lagbe (Bearer token na). Body: {"teacher_id": "..."}

action=run_batch -> raat-er batch job manually trigger kora (admin-only role: R_SUPERADMIN / R_SCHOOLADMIN / R_BRANCHADMIN). Body: {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"} (optional, default gotokal).

action=branch_rule -> branch-wise full/half-day rule set kora (admin-only). Body: {"branch_id", "full_day_min_hrs", "half_day_min_hrs"}.

action=mark_student_attendance -> ekta single student-er class-wise attendance mark kora (shudhu shei class-e assigned teacher nijer login diye korte parbe). Body: {"schedule_id"/"SCHL_CLS_SCHLDL_ID", "student_id"/"STU_STU_ID", "date"/"ATT_DT" (optional), "status"/"STU_PRES" (optional, default Present)}.

parameters.name: X-Device-Key
parameters.description: Biometric device shared secret. .env-e ATTENDANCE_DEVICE_KEY set na thakle default 'CHANGE_ME_DEVICE_KEY' babohar hoy — deploy korar age eta must set korte hobe.

schema.description: Fields vary by action — dekho operation description e.

403.description: Role not permitted, or teacher not assigned to this class

get.description: action=class_roster -> ekta class-schedule-er shob student ebong tader aajker attendance status (Present/Absent/Not Marked) dekhay — higher-class (11-12) manual tick-mark UI-r jonyo. Login-kora teacher shei schedule-e assigned na hole 403 dey. Query: schedule_id (required), date (optional, default aaj).

403.description: Login-kora user Teacher record-e linked na, othoba ei class-e assigned na

post.summary: Class-wise ba single-student attendance mark kora (tick-mark save)
post.description:
action=mark_class_attendance -> pura class-er tick-marked attendance ekbare save kora. Body: {"schedule_id", "date" (optional), "students": [{"student_id", "status"}, ...]}.

action=mark_student_attendance -> EK student-er attendance (single row). Body: {"schedule_id"/"SCHL_CLS_SCHLDL_ID", "student_id"/"STU_STU_ID", "date"/"ATT_DT" (optional), "status"/"STU_PRES" (optional, default Present)}.

Duitai case-e: login-kora teacher-ke shei class-schedule-e assigned thakte hobe, noyle 403. STU_TCHR_ID always JWT theke resolve hoy, client theke pathano jay na.

403.description: Login-kora user linked na, othoba ei class-e assigned na
